verdict.rationale: Context.dev ships an official MCP server and CLI/skill install guides so an AI agent or coding assistant can translate natural-language requests into API calls, and its Answers endpoint directly accepts a natural-language 'question or task' and returns JSON with sources. However, the core product remains a structured REST API (JSON Schema extraction, explicit parameters) rather than a native NL interface, so operating it in natural language depends on an external AI client/agent layer. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party chat/NL interface within Context.dev itself, and independent hands-on confirmation that MCP/agent NL commands reliably map to correct API calls.
